hero.subheadline: Fachinformatiker Wiki is a community-driven platform for IT apprentices in Germany. Self-made learning materials, seasoned professionals and verified IHK examiners — all in one place.

features.headline: Everything for your training
features.subheadline: An active community of apprentices, industry professionals and IHK examiners — so you're fully prepared for your final exam.

items.title: Self-made Learning Materials
items.desc: Study guides, summaries and practice tasks created by apprentices for apprentices — practical and tailored to the IHK exam.

items.title: Ask Questions & Get Answers
items.desc: Post your questions in the forum and get answers from experienced IT professionals and verified IHK examiners.

items.title: Verified IHK Examiners
items.desc: Real IHK examiners are part of our community. Get direct insight into exam expectations and grading criteria straight from the source.

items.title: GitHub Community
items.desc: Learn through real projects on our GitHub. Collaborative coding, code reviews and open-source contributions with people who work in the field every day.

items.title: Study Groups & Community Events
items.desc: Organised study groups and exam prep events — learning together is more effective and you're never alone on the road to your exam.

items.title: Support from Professionals
items.desc: Benefit from the experience of active IT professionals across different specialisations — system integration, application development and more.

items.title: Free — Forever
items.desc: Everything we offer is and always will be free. We know apprentices don't have a big budget — and we have no interest in profiting from that. No subscriptions, no paywalls, no hidden costs.
